altText: Taylor Swift in a sequined two-piece during the 1989 set of the Eras Tour, Inglewood 2023, shown close up on the stadium screen beside her on stage.
body: one show. that's all we got from Taylor in the whole of 2016, and she played it at the Formula 1 U.S. Grand Prix in Austin on october 22. a year of missing her and then a racetrack?? i'd have bought the ticket and never watched a single lap 🏎️ https://www.longlivets.com/?item=vault-1989-her-only-concert-of-2016-at-the-formula-1-u-s-grand-prix&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=heartbeat
